status: PROPOSED authored geometry for static art; NOT implemented, collision-tested or path-length validated
coordinate_system: Normalized image coordinates; origin top-left; x right, y down; bounds [x,y,width,height]. Images1254x1254 native RGB opaque.

shared.world_size_note: Prototype starting suggestion only. Validate actual adjacency/door travel≤6 walking tiles and camp distance≤36; do not infer these from pixels.
shared.geometry_note: Conservative clear central travel union, not full walk mesh. Extend corridors into prop approach alcoves after tracing exact collision. Use server geometry for walls/occlusion and paint overlays; pixels do not decide movement.
shared.closed_boundary_note: All four illustrated ports are open art. Game must overlay sealed boundaries/doors for undiscovered branches; never reveal unopened room plates. Do not use this art as topology authority.
shared.occlusion_note: Flattened walls/props are already in plate. Start with conservative solid props and separate occluder geometry. For characters walking behind wall faces or stateful props, extract/rebuild foreground layers in a later art pass.
shared.lighting_note: Static base colors include mild shading. Runtime light/cone/fog and Safe Zone eligibility are server-derived; a lit ordinary room is not a camp.
shared.privacy_note: No natural-exit clues are baked into these plates. Actual opening is a separate revealed-only feature. Never infer secret roles, wallets or live distant occupancy from room art.
shared.state_swap_note: State variants visually preserve the plate footprint and door positions. They are image-generated edits, not guaranteed pixel-identical background layers; review transitions in-engine. State images communicate condition only; server controls availability. Trap art never adds a physical immobilization location rule.

rooms.qa: Visually reviewed; centered ports and central travel lanes clear. Interaction anchors/prop bounds are author estimates, not measured pixel collision.
